title: Happy zebra
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- sky-free plain background: none -->
  <!-- zebra body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='28' ry='18' fill='#f4f4f8'/>
  <!-- stripes on body -->
  <path d='M30 48 Q36 62 30 78' stroke='#3b3b6b' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M44 46 Q50 62 44 80' stroke='#3b3b6b' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M58 46 Q64 62 58 80' stroke='#3b3b6b' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M72 50 Q78 62 72 76' stroke='#3b3b6b' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='30' y='76' width='7' height='16' rx='3' fill='#f4f4f8'/>
  <rect x='63' y='76' width='7' height='16' rx='3' fill='#f4f4f8'/>
  <rect x='30' y='76' width='7' height='6' rx='2' fill='#3b3b6b'/>
  <rect x='63' y='76' width='7' height='6' rx='2' fill='#3b3b6b'/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x='29' y='89' width='9' height='5' rx='2' fill='#5a5a7a'/>
  <rect x='62' y='89' width='9' height='5' rx='2' fill='#5a5a7a'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <path d='M74 58 Q82 50 84 40 L92 42 Q90 55 80 64 Z' fill='#f4f4f8'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='86' cy='36' rx='13' ry='11' fill='#f4f4f8'/>
  <!-- head stripes -->
  <path d='M80 27 Q82 36 80 45' stroke='#3b3b6b' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M88 26 Q90 36 88 46' stroke='#3b3b6b' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='80' cy='23' rx='3.5' ry='6' fill='#f4f4f8' transform='rotate(-15 80 23)'/>
  <ellipse cx='91' cy='23' rx='3.5' ry='6' fill='#f4f4f8' transform='rotate(15 91 23)'/>
  <ellipse cx='80' cy='23' rx='1.8' ry='3.5' fill='#e8a0c0' transform='rotate(-15 80 23)'/>
  <ellipse cx='91' cy='23' rx='1.8' ry='3.5' fill='#e8a0c0' transform='rotate(15 91 23)'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='95' cy='40' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#ffd0e0'/>
  <circle cx='93' cy='39' r='1.2' fill='#3b3b6b'/>
  <circle cx='97' cy='39' r='1.2' fill='#3b3b6b'/>
  <!-- happy smile -->
  <path d='M91 43 Q95 47 99 43' stroke='#3b3b6b' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='84' cy='34' r='2.2' fill='#3b3b6b'/>
  <circle cx='84' cy='33.5' r='0.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- mane -->
  <path d='M76 22 Q72 30 74 40 Q70 34 72 26 Z' fill='#3b3b6b'/>
  <path d='M74 40 Q70 48 72 56 Q68 48 70 40 Z' fill='#3b3b6b'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M22 58 Q14 56 12 64' stroke='#f4f4f8' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M12 64 Q10 70 13 72' stroke='#3b3b6b' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- rosy cheek -->
  <circle cx='81' cy='39' r='2.5' fill='#ffb0c8' opacity='0.9'/>
</svg>
